lines.text: QUEST ACCEPTED: {task}. The dungeon trembles, as it should.
{task}. I once ruled a continent, and I declare this quest equally epic. Onward.
Quest log updated: {task}. Objective one: begin. Reward: glory, and also the task being done.
{task}: an ancient quest from the bottom of the scroll. Legendary loot drops for those who return to it.
A fresh quest, accepted the day it appeared: {task}. Speedrun energy. I approve.
QUEST COMPLETE: {task}. +50 XP, +1 tidy dominion. Rest at the inn or accept the next quest; the choice is yours.
{task} is defeated. Loot acquired: one less thing on the list. Buff active: +10 calm.
The raid boss {task} has fallen. Bards will sing of it. Next quest, or a well-earned rest at the inn?
{task}, the quest that lingered for weeks, is CLEARED. Rare achievement unlocked. Claim your rest.
QUEST COMPLETE: {task}. Even a former demon king stands in awe. Choose the next quest, or rest and restore mana.
A new day dawns over the dominion. First quest: {task}. Daily bonus XP applies.
The quest board refreshes. One cleared quest is enough to earn the day's XP.
Daily quest unlocked: {task}. Party size: one legend.
{task} cleared, and a few days in a row now. Combo multiplier active.
Several days of cleared quests. The dominion grows. My studio apartment has never felt so mighty.
Ten days and more of victories. Title earned: The Unwavering. Even my old armies never managed that.
The hero returns. The quest board is fresh, and {task} glows upon it.
Welcome back, adventurer. Full health, full mana, and a fresh quest board.
The campaign continues. Today's quest: {task}. XP awaits.
Even a demon king logs off. Close the app; the quest happens out in the world.
This menu screen grants no XP. Close the app and go clear the quest.
The inn is closing for now. Close the app and rest, or go adventuring.
{task} is a raid boss. I have divided it into three phases. Phase one only, for now.
Behold: {task}, split into three small quests. Each one drops loot.
A new chapter of my dominion's history is unlocked. Read it at the inn, once the questing is done.
Lore unlocked. The tale of my studio kingdom continues. It will keep until you rest.
